li.p: The tailgate locks or unlocks when you lock or unlock all the doors with the smart key or the central door lock switch.
If you press the tailgate unlock button on the smart key for approximately 1 second, only the tailgate unlocks.
If the tailgate is unlocked, you can open it by pressing the handle and pulling it up.
Once you open and close the tailgate, it locks automatically. All doors must be locked.

note.p: In cold and wet climates, the door lock and door mechanisms may not work properly due to freezing conditions.
The tailgate swings upward. Make sure no objects or people are near the rear of the vehicle when opening the tailgate.
Make sure to close the tailgate before driving your vehicle. Possible damage to the tailgate gas lifters and attached hardware may occur if you do not close the tailgate prior to driving.
